description: This Java class implements the ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve provisioning criteria data and templates, execute database queries, and map SQL result sets to data objects within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformService interface, handling data retrieval and mapping for provisioning criteria.

methods.name: retrievePrivisiongCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning criteria template with default categories, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: retrievePrivisiongCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning criteria template using provided data, adding categories, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: constructCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Constructs a collection of provisioning criteria definitions from categories.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningCriterias
methods.description: Retrieves all provisioning criteria records from the database.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a ProvisioningCriteriaData object for criteria.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema for provisioning criteria.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a specific provisioning criteria by ID, including associated loan products and definitions.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning definitions linked to a specific criteria ID.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a ResultSet row to a ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionData object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema for provisioning criteria definitions.

methods.name: retrieveCriteriaName
methods.description: Fetches the criteria name for a given ID.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a ResultSet row to a String representing criteria name.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for the criteria name schema.
